set.name: Drežnik Brezovički
set.question: Which Drežnik does the book of Orthodox deaths 1796–1818 listed here belong to? Not established. FamilySearch and the published holdings of the Croatian State Archives call the parish only “Drežnik”. It was put at this point by the name alone, and nothing read so far ties it to Drežnik Brezovički. Other villages have the name: near Nova Gradiška, and Drežnik Grad near Rakovica, which Serbian Wikipedia gives as a filial of the Orthodox parish of Sadilovac in the early 1900s (a lead, not proof).

fixes.evidence: GeoNames and hr.wikipedia: the point 45.7224, 15.8955 is Drežnik Brezovički, City of Zagreb. Read 26 November 2026.

add.name: Drežnik (Nova Gradiška)
add.question: No volume is listed for this Drežnik. A book of Orthodox deaths 1796–1818 called only “Drežnik” is listed under Drežnik Brezovički (Zagreb); which Drežnik it belongs to is not established.
